r.경제 체제: Market economy · tourism, free-zone manufacturing, remittances
r.생활 물가 수준: 38% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 30%, Trucks 16%, Electronics, electrical equipment 10%, Machinery, computers 8% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Medical devices 52%, Pharmaceuticals 16%, Aluminum 8%, Copper 8% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A presidential system and a fairly stable democracy.

t.why: One of the fastest-growing economies in the Caribbean, with large tourism and manufacturing sectors.
t.rel: It shares an island with Haiti and tightly controls the border over migration from Haiti. One of the fastest-growing economies in the Caribbean.
t.know: One of the countries that sends the most players to Major League Baseball.
t.etext: It has grown fast on tourism, special economic zones making medical devices and clothing, and remittances from the United States. It also sells gold and nickel. Its growth rate is high for Latin America.
